answer: Haven delivery-commitment bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a plan with a violet seal at the haven. It must deliver by the deadline; a glacier audit replays the log and checks the seal. A missed or copied delivery burns the bond; repeats climb: first miss 40, kth 40+8(k-1). A rented-delivery ring pays 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked for 1,000 fakes, pool 40,000. An honest agent files one plan, delivers, pays 40 once, keeps the bond.
